0: Ore below, timber above, tracks across the middle. A full day.
The bag is not big enough for all of this. Tried anyway.
Started underground. Finished in the canopy. §oOr the reverse. Hard to say.
Scent through the trees, stone at the roots, ore underneath all of it.
Three trails crossing in the same clearing. Followed all three.
Worked from soil to bark to bone, all in a morning.
Stone, tree, quarry. The day did not wait for me to choose.
Axe, pick, nose. Each one got a turn. None of them waited.
The bag took from each. Still had room. Filled it.
Two tools and one good nose. Covered the ground.

light: Something for everyone today, including the hazards.
Three minor problems in three minutes. Took them in turn.
Slipped, stuck, scratched. §oThe trifecta of small troubles. Walked it off.
Tools tangled three ways. Sorted two of them. The third sorted itself.
Each role picked up a small reminder of why it is hard.
The stone, the §ltree, and the §lmob all had opinions. Listened to none of them.
moderate: §cThree problems. One paw at a time.

§cAll three trades wanted me at once. §oPicked the loudest first.
§cWrong tool in each paw. §oSwitched twice before settling.
§cCould only do two of the three at once. Did the third after.
§cBag got heavy in the wrong order. §oRe-stacked it without putting it down.
